name: MomoCon
blurb: An all-ages geek-culture convention in Atlanta for anime, gaming and comics fans, with voice actors, animators and YouTube creators each May.

picks: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, Powerpuff Girls
Attack on Titan (Eren), Sword Art Online (Kirito)

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'May 27-30, 2027 REGISTER FOR 2027!'; guest page labelled 'MomoCon Guest List 2027'; WebSearch confirmed venue as Georgia World Congress Center, Downtown Atlanta

notes: Guest cards gave only names (no bio text), so categories/known-for were filled from general knowledge plus a WebSearch that confirmed Katie Caruso (voice actor), ToonrificTariq (animation YouTuber/essayist) and Johnny 2 Cellos (his co-host on the 'Cartoons That Curse' podcast, not a musical act as the name might suggest). Breana Navickas, Katy Johnson, ACRacebest and Jaxblade could not be confirmed, so their known-for is left blank; Corey Wilder is grouped with the anime-dub voice cast but his specific roles could not be confirmed either. No og/twitter image on the homepage; cover uses the official site logo. Verify-05 recheck (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh extraction shows the identical 21 names directly under an on-page 'MomoCon Guest List 2027' banner.
